identityReference.description: Approved Silent skin identity sheet: original anime heroine in a green hood, acid-green slit-pupil eyes, vial bandolier, jade snake ring, two poison daggers (generated, not committed)

poster.description: Monogatari series second-season key art: extreme low camera angle, cloudless cobalt sky, white geometric masts, stacked diagonal figures (copyrighted, not committed)

closeup.description: Monogatari series close-up frame: huge flat eyes with crisp highlights, shard-like flat hair, fine linework, painted sea and cloud backdrop (copyrighted, not committed)

classroom.description: Monogatari series group frame: hard diagonal shadow cuts, cracked grey wall with one hot flat colour panel, geometric clutter, long limbs (copyrighted, not committed)

cards.scene: She crouches low and flicks a handful of small iron caltrop stars across a stone floor toward the camera, seen from a high angle, the spikes scattering in a flat spiral, one hard diagonal shadow cut across the floor.

Low camera angle: she thrusts a reverse-grip dagger toward the lens again and again, three thin repeated motion arcs of the same blade stacked on a diagonal, head tilted, a flat hot panel colour behind her.
She opens her hand and lets a fan of discarded playing cards fall away, each card leaving one thin white slash line in the air, a symmetric emblem composition with her calm face centred above.
Close low-angle shot of her thrusting a clear glass dagger, the blade transparent pale green with a long crack down its centre and a few shards flying off, her hooded face tilted behind it.
A long leg sweeps in a low arc as she hooks an enemy silhouette's ankle with her heel, the foe toppling backwards, seen side-on from a high angle, hard diagonal shadow polygons on the floor.
She sits calm and cross-legged while a huge ghostly pale-green double of herself leans over her from behind like a dream, the double holding a floating card, tilted heads, shadow-cut staging.
A pale ghostly green copy of her rises behind her with both daggers lifted, she stands in the foreground deadpan, symmetric emblem composition with calm margins.
A clean single dagger strike: she lunges forward in profile with one poison dagger slashing a bright diagonal line across the frame, low camera angle under a cloudless saturated sky, hood tilting.
She crosses both poison daggers in front of her chest in a guard, head tilted, cloak flaring, hard diagonal shadow behind her and one flat panel of colour.
She throws a dagger that pins an enemy silhouette's sleeve to a cracked wall, a small green gas wisp rising from the wound-free sleeve, she stands relaxed with a pointed finger.
She crouches and pulls her cloak around herself while flicking one card away with two fingers, a smoke vial dropping, low angle, deep shadow cut.
A side-on throw: her arm fully extended after releasing a dagger that streaks toward the right edge with three thin speed lines, long limbs, flat sky.
High angle looking straight down: she kneels over a cloth laid with daggers and glass vials in neat rows, checking one dagger, her hood and scarf making simple shapes.
Five thrown daggers fan out across the frame and pin a silhouetted target, tiny bright round holes of light riddling it, she stands at the left edge with her arm still extended.
She dashes forward in a very low long lunge across the frame, cloak streaming behind, dagger trailing, flat horizontal speed bands, low camera angle.

Seen from a high angle she spins gracefully on one foot with both arms stretched out, a ring of many small throwing knives fanning outward from her hands in a flat spiral toward the walls of an empty courtyard, bold radial composition, no people near her.
She cups one hand beside her mouth and sends out three bold concentric rings of sound, cracked grey wall behind and enemy silhouettes recoiling at the edges.
She smashes a vial at an enemy silhouette's feet and a billowing flat acid-green cloud rolls up around the legs, she steps back with a covered scarf, hard shadow cut.
Close-up of her long fingers (jade snake ring visible) dipping a dagger tip into a small vial, a single acid-green drop falling, her half-shadowed eyes in the corner.
Low angle thrust: a dagger dripping bright acid-green poison driven forward toward the camera, her slit-pupil eyes watching over it, flat cel colour.
She sweeps both arms outward and three daggers fan out in a spray like a folding fan, wide arc, long limbs, a cobalt-teal flat sky behind.
Low camera angle on her mid backflip, upside-down tilted head, cloak and scarf trailing in simple shapes, long legs tucked, cloudless sky.
She vaults over a white railing with one hand on the bar, long legs scissoring, a few drawn cards fluttering behind, white geometric architecture against the sky.
She lunges with both daggers pointing along one strong diagonal line toward a target silhouette that is impaled on the line, deadpan face, low camera.
She turns in a slow dance inside a circle of three floating shivs that orbit her like a mobile, arms long and elegant, high angle, one flat hot panel behind.
She wraps her long green cloak across her body as a shield while one dagger glints out of its folds, head tilted under the hood.
She steps out of a hard black shadow polygon behind an unsuspecting guard silhouette, dagger raised, finger to her lips, tilted head.
High camera looking down at a cowering enemy silhouette while she looms from below the frame with huge acid-green slit-pupil eyes glowing, a stark flat shadow cut.
She stands directly behind an enemy silhouette and drives a dagger into its back, the foe arching and its head thrown back, hard diagonal shadow cut, no gore.
She prowls low along a ledge like a cat, shoulders down, eyes fixed on prey, long limbs, seen from a high angle with white geometric architecture.
A long low leg sweep arcs across the floor in a flat circle motion line while an enemy silhouette topples backwards, she balances on one hand, seen side-on from a high camera.
One decisive diagonal dagger slice drawing a bright thin white arc across the whole frame, she is a long dark diagonal silhouette behind it.
She bats a thrown dagger aside with her own blade, small flat white stars of sparks, a close tilted face with one sharp eye in the corner.
She tumbles in a low forward roll under a swinging spear that cuts the air where she stood, motion arcs, long limbs, flat floor.
She drives a dagger into an already poisoned enemy silhouette, thin green veins of poison spreading across it like branching lines, calm face, shadow cut.
Her hands crush a vial into a flask and a small green gas puff splits into two large clouds, close shot on long fingers and the jade snake ring.
She flicks a fan of slim needle flechettes from her fingertips toward the camera in thin parallel lines, hand large in the foreground, low angle.
She tilts a small vial to her lips, a bright burst of acid-green light flashes behind her and flat speed lines radiate, her eyes wide with slit pupils.
High angle: she stands calm at the centre of a hall of scattered daggers all pointing at one point, the last dagger flying in, many thin white slashes forming a star across the frame.
She stands deadpan at the centre of a flat circular field of countless thin white slash lines converging around her, emblem composition with calm margins.
She exhales a sickly green mist over an enemy silhouette that wilts and sags, drooping posture, she holds her scarf over her mouth, hard shadow cut.
Two overlapping poses of her casting the same move, an echo twin offset by a few degrees, flat graphic doubling, a snap of her fingers in the centre.
She stands calm and tilted while a ring of thrown daggers hangs frozen in the air around her at slow spaced intervals, an enemy silhouette far away, cloudless sky.
A slain enemy silhouette bursts into a flat white-and-green blast of shards behind her as she walks away without looking back, low angle.
She faces her own mirror twin, one in dark green and one inverted in bone white, mirrored composition, hands almost touching, a hot flat panel between them.
She dissolves into three horizontal-slice motion copies of herself sliding sideways, each slightly offset, flat speed stripes, dagger in hand.
High angle: she tucks a dagger into her boot top while planning, a single card tucked in her cloak, a tilted pensive head, bright floor geometry.
She flings a huge spray of daggers outward in a low wide sweep covering the whole frame, cloak flaring, low camera, dynamic diagonals.
Close shot on her long fingers handling five daggers and a vial with practiced ease, a half-smile hint, the jade snake ring prominent.
She tosses a small die high into the air with a deadpan tilted face, the die at the top of its arc, cloudless sky and white geometry.
She catches a thrown dagger by its handle an inch from her face, one wide acid-green eye in the frame, tight close-up.
She studies a small tabletop of tiny carved pieces from above with a sidelong glance and a card held in her fingers, pointed chin, classroom-style shadow cut.
Emblem composition: three flat ghostly copies of her stepping in the same stance in a staggered row behind the solid heroine, fading in tone, calm margins.
She runs along a rooftop edge, a smoke vial dropping and bursting behind her, a long diagonal composition against a cloudless sky.
She delivers a final stab as the enemy silhouette crumples, a row of tiny slash marks on the wall behind showing the earlier hits, low camera.
Close-up of a dagger point touching one glowing weak spot on a silhouette, her long fingers precise, her slit eyes reflected in the blade.
She slips neatly aside past a charging heavy silhouette in a graceful step, hood tilted, flat floor and diagonal shadows.
Emblem composition: she aims a thin dagger, concentric target rings and thin sight lines converging precisely on its tip, calm centred pose.
A taut thin wire stretched between her gloved hands behind a struggling enemy silhouette, non-graphic, her face calm over the shoulder, shadow cut.
Low angle close-up of her wrapped boot stepping lightly on a stone ledge, other leg long behind, dust puff as flat shapes, cloudless sky.
Emblem composition: she sits calmly at a table laid out with daggers and vials in a perfect row, one card tucked away in her cloak.
A spiral of floating daggers emerging one after another from her open palm into an endless coil, centred emblem, calm margins.
She stands poised as green fumes curl up from the vials on her bandolier around her, flat spiral shapes, symmetric emblem composition.
Symmetric emblem composition: one dagger with a bead of acid-green poison hanging from its tip, a row of vials above it, her eyes in the corner.
She turns translucent, a ghostly pale green outline floating just above the floor, her cloak dissolving into mist, calm face, high contrast, emblem composition.
A rolled-out leather kit holding daggers, vials and the jade snake ring, her long fingers drawing one tool, high angle, emblem composition.
A poison flask bounces between two walls along a dotted path, three flat green splashes, she stands at the corner with her arm extended.
She stands with eyes narrowed and one vial held under her nose, quiet breathing, discarded cards falling from her other hand, shadow cut.
Emblem composition: she flicks a coin aside while an enemy silhouette turns its head, and slides out of the opposite side of the frame.
A storm of thrown blades radiates from her as she crouches low with arms wide, low camera, radial diagonal composition.
She empties her whole bandolier in a rapid line of thrown knives across the frame on one tight diagonal, her arm sweeping, a hot flat panel behind.
